export_pytorch_model_to_predictor: run the exporter CLI to convert a pytorch detectron2go model to a deployable predictor format
export_model_with_skip_if_fail: run the exporter with --skip-if-fail to continue exporting other predictor types after one fails
export_model_without_weights: run the exporter with --skip-model-weights to export a model without loading pretrained weights
export_model_to_specific_device: run the exporter with --device gpu to export the pytorch model for a specific target device
review_ExporterOutput_dataclass: review the ExporterOutput dataclass that holds predictor paths and accuracy comparison results
